trace.query: What haircut must male 2nd to 4th year college students follow?

retrieved_chunks.text:
SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_528
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 4. Norms and Decorum The following are not allowed or strictly prohibited for male and female students.
which they usually fasten with hair ties or stiffen with gel

2.3. Departure from approved hair-cut below:

2.3.1. 2x3 - for male Freshmen and Senior High School Students

2.3.2. Clean-cut or 1x2 barbers/decent cut - for 2nd to 4th year College students who are through with their ROTC/CWTS S.O.P. hair cut inspection every first (1st) Monday of the month (by Guard-on-Duty/ Chief of Security/ OSAS Director/ Chairperson)

Sec. 3. Inappropriate Earrings

3.1. For female students: ornamental, dropped, dangling, nose, eyebrow, tongue, upper and lower-lip lobe earrings display is prohibited.

3.2. For male students: wearing of any kind of earrings is strictly prohibited.

Sec. 4. Wearing of Cap. Wearing of cap/head gear inside any offices, hall, centers, room is prohibited for both male and female students.

Sec. 5. Tattooing. Permanent tattooing on the exposed part of the body is strictly prohibited.

Sec. 6. Clothing and Gender Representation. LSPU may enforce dress codes pursuant to the university policy as specified in student hand book.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_527
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 4. Norms and Decorum The following are not allowed or strictly prohibited for male and female students.
and not very tight fitting.

1.4. Society/Organization uniforms shall be worn on specific occasions (parade, competitions, seminars, trainings, workshops, conferences) only.

1.5. For On-Campus/Off-Campus Trainings, there should be an official style and color of uniform to those who will undergo OJT/ practicum/ internship/practice teaching, hence, in case of changes in uniform, the Business Affairs Office in coordination with the Office of Student Affairs and Services shall be properly informed.

Sec. 2. Hair Style/Hair-cut The following are prohibited in the university:

2.1. Colored/tinted/dyed differently (out of the ordinary) styled hair is not an academic requirement; (hair-dyeing and hair coloring for both male and female is allowed on a minimal aesthetic level and appropriate personal needs only upon the approval of the OSAS and the Campus Director)

2.2. Funky short or fixie crop (shaven side and long top) hairstyles among male students, which they usually fasten with hair ties or stiffen with gel

2.3. Departure from approved hair-cut below:

2.3.1. 2x3 - for male Freshmen and Senior High School Students

2.3.2.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_530
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 4. Norms and Decorum The following are not allowed or strictly prohibited for male and female students.
i.e. pants and polo but with female cut blouses of same color with male uniforms and Transman will be allowed to wear pants and polo but with same color of the female uniform.

6.2 Grooming rules and restrictions, including rules regarding hair, make-up, shaving, etc., shall be the same in male and female units.

Transgender girls shall not be required to have a male haircut provided that their hair should be clipped properly (men’s tail or fold over style), or to wear masculine clothing. Transgender boys shall not be required to maintain a female hairstyle, to wear make-up, or to wear feminine clothing.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_526
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 4. Norms and Decorum The following are not allowed or strictly prohibited for male and female students.
offense during washdays, (Wednesday and inter-semester classes).

The following attires or apparels are strictly prohibited inside the campus:

1.3.1. Shorts/short pants

1.3.2. Walking Shorts, cycling shorts

1.3.3. Pedal pusher pants

1.3.4. Capri pants

1.3.5. “Puruntong” style or Cargo shorts

1.3.6. Mutilated/Jazzed pants

1.3.7. Faded, torn, wrinkled shirts

1.3.8. Jogging pants / Jogger pants

1.3.9. Miniskirts

1.3.10. Sleeveless, backless, venus de milo neck (one sleeve type), spaghetti type shirt and blouse

1.3.11. Sandos or sando type sleeveless shirt

1.3.12. Plunging necklines/halter tops

1.3.13. Leggings

1.3.14. Slippers Note: Female pants should be slacks or loosely cut trousers, not made up of denim/maong and not very tight fitting.

1.4. Society/Organization uniforms shall be worn on specific occasions (parade, competitions, seminars, trainings, workshops, conferences) only.

1.5.
